title: Width-three Tseitin construction
statement: Given a CNF formula on $n$ coordinates and a natural number $w$, let $c$ be the number of clauses in the formula. The construction is a CNF formula on $n+(w-3)c$ coordinates whose clauses are obtained by concatenating, in clause order, the width-three Tseitin clause blocks associated with the input formula, $w$, and each clause index.
caveat: The clause-block construction is referenced but not defined in the supplied snippet, so its clauses cannot be described more explicitly.
